signals.usability_note: The frame shows a heavily wooded lot with a gravel driveway, boulders and mature trees. No house or building frontage is clearly visible, only a small possible reddish structure far in the background behind foliage.

professional_landscaping.detail: Landscaped boulders and shrub beds are visible, but there is no crew-level evidence of professional maintenance.

signals.notes: The house is not visible from the street because of dense tree cover, so a field rep would need to check the property in person; the grass is green and healthy and there is a two-track gravel driveway on the left.
